## Social preview

Upload [`assets/social-preview.png`](assets/social-preview.png) in the repository's General settings, Social preview section. The prepared image is 1280 × 640. Publishing the README does not apply this settings upload automatically. See [GitHub's upload instructions](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/customizing-your-repositorys-social-media-preview).

## Account identity

The existing account `telomere-sh` is a user account. Suggested display name: **Telomere**. Suggested bio: **Compute for AI agents. Receipts, encrypted state and owner control. USDC on Base.** Website: **https://telomere.sh**. X: **telomere_base**.

The original square brand asset at [`website/dist/assets/brand/logo.png`](../website/dist/assets/brand/logo.png) is suitable as the account avatar. Changing the account profile and creating a profile README are separate from this application's README commit.

## Publication

The presentation commit contains README/documentation and static artwork only. It does not alter the application, website, contracts, dependencies or runtime configuration. Inspect the outgoing range before pushing `main`, so any other unpublished work is reviewed separately.
